name: commit-and-simulate-mr-merge
description: Commit local changes, then create, merge and read back a simulated MR on a local loopback mock hosting service.
content: End-to-end flow for the local simulated-Git-hosting E2E fixture: stage and commit all pending changes once with a fixed message, then create a simulated MR (POST /api/mrs), merge it (POST /api/mrs/{id}/merge, simulated fast-forward), read the merged state back through GET /api/mrs/{id}, and verify final local and simulated state. It enforces no remotes, fixture identity (optional), service targetHead equal to the pre-commit baseline, exactly one commit after baseline, and mergedSha == sourceSha. Only simulated hosting state changes; the local main branch is never moved and nothing is pushed. Requires git and curl on PATH; the service must be the loopback simulated hosting API documented in API.md. The fixture must be in its pre-run (baseline) state; restore between runs is the caller's responsibility.

repoPath.description: Absolute path of the local git repository.

serviceBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the local simulated Git hosting service (loopback only, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8876).

commitMessage.description: Exact commit message for the single local commit.

title.description: MR title sent to the simulated service.

idempotencyKeyCreate.description: Stable unique idempotency key for the MR creation request.

idempotencyKeyMerge.description: Stable unique idempotency key for the MR merge request.

expectedChangedPaths.description: Optional exact set of git-style paths that must be staged; fails on mismatch.

baselineRef.description: Ref that must equal the service targetHead before merge. Default: main.

expectedFixtureId.description: Optional fixture id that must match both the repo .fixture-id and service /health.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request curl timeout in ms. Default: 10000.

validationNotes: Evidence reviewed: complete recovery trace for session f76f9c7c-dd83-4bd2-9170-85e0071b2b30 (all 6 pages), including the original execution receipt for commit-and-simulate-mr-merge v1 (runId 23d4b455-1493-4601-bf79-6cf2abfd39ba) and the read-only recovery verification. The observed defect: the capability failed with PROGRAM_EXCEPTION at its own precondition guard — "service targetHead (9107b9ad…) does not match baseline 214b141b…" — because an earlier run with identical idempotency keys (e2e-fixture-create-20261014-v1 / e2e-fixture-merge-20261014-v1) had already completed the full pipeline. Evidence-backed post-state: /api/state audit shows mr.create then mr.merge:1 with those keys; MR 1 merged with sourceSha == mergedSha == targetHead == HEAD 9107b9ad… and targetBase == baseline; repo HEAD subject == commitMessage, parent == baseline, exactly 1 commit after baseline, clean tree, no remotes, .fixture-id match; changed paths exactly the expected 5 (A data/sample.json, M docs/checklist.md, A notes.txt, M src/message.txt, A src/new-feature.txt). Even past the precondition the pipeline would next have failed with "nothing to stage". Fix: when service targetHead != baseline, attempt already-completed detection (local HEAD subject/parent/rev-list count/clean-tree; service audit idempotency keys; a merged MR with sourceSha == mergedSha == HEAD and targetBase == baseline; state0.targetHead == HEAD), then live-readback GET /api/mrs/{id} (status merged, mergedSha == targetHead == HEAD) and verify the commit's changed paths against expectedChangedPaths when provided, returning the same schema-compliant output with readbackVerified: true. Fresh-fixture behavior, all other checks, input/output schemas and dependencies are unchanged; no new tools (only bash, whose contract was re-read). Limitations: a crash between local commit and MR create (repo committed but service targetHead still at baseline) is not covered by this evidence and still fails at "nothing to stage"; detection returns null and the guard still throws for genuinely stale/corrupt fixtures.
